title: Exact stationary Fisher and Wick-defect gap identity

gap_identity.matching_gaussian: For stationary finite-Fisher bar rho of finite full energy, in particular finite fourth moment/Wick expectation, with mean m and positive covariance S, gamma=N(m,S) is stationary because m is translation fixed and S commutes with translations.
gap_identity.score_residual: R_(Omega,N)=E_bar rho[(u-u_gamma)^T Omega_N(u-u_gamma)]>=0 and I_Omega(bar rho)=I_Omega(gamma)+R_(Omega,N).
gap_identity.moment_defect: D_N=int_[T^3](4h mu3+mu4-3v^2)dx is the exact K1534 non-Gaussian Wick defect.
gap_identity.gaussian_gap: A_N=Q_N(gamma)-lambda_N^statG>=0, where lambda_N^statG is the stationary-Gaussian infimum.
gap_identity.normalization: The factor 1/4 multiplies only relative Fisher information; the Wick defect has coefficient g.
gap_identity.scope_guard: Finite Fisher alone does not imply the finite fourth moment needed for D_N; on the stated finite-full-energy domain the identity has no sign for D_N and is not by itself a coercivity or unrestricted-coefficient theorem.
